Description
Centennial College of Applied Arts and Technology is a diploma- and degree-granting college located in Toronto, Ontario, Canada and is the oldest publicly funded college in the region. Centennial College offers full-time programs in more than 100 fields of study. These programs emphasize experiential learning with laboratory instruction, paid co-operative education opportunities, and industry and agency field placements.
